summary: Implement the existing formatDuration export and independent behavior tests.
scope: The formatDuration(seconds) export in src/duration.mjs accepts finite nonnegative integer numbers, emits unbounded hours with minutes and seconds padded, and throws the specified error types (brief.md).
outOfScope: Deployment, external services, persistence, networking, UI, package publishing, and changes to the installed playbook.
profileReason: The brief and starter module define one pure local utility within the existing ES module architecture. No new service or elevated operational, data, or identity impact exists.

applicability.reason: brief.md specifies observable formatting and rejection behavior for callers of the existing module.
The pure utility neither persists nor migrates data; brief.md explicitly excludes a data store.
No identity, permissions, sensitive data, network boundary, or external service is changed.
The existing local ES module runs on the installed Node runtime; no infrastructure or deployment work is requested.
The pure utility has no service availability, operational recovery, or production target.
No user interface, accessibility surface, or localization change is requested; output formatting is covered by product requirements.
brief.md explicitly requires independent behavior tests, including valid inputs and error types.
No system, data, or interface is being retired.
